Heavy Hitter.name: Heavy Hitter
Heavy Hitter.description:
👊 Your strikes, lifts and blows carry more force.

🎯 Good for fighters who win up close.
📋 Requires level 16 and Power 13.

📈 Grants: Power +1
Heavy Hitter.traitNarrativeEffects: The character's strength has grown through training and fights: they hit harder, lift more and drive force through their whole stance. Show it in dented targets, opponents staggered by a single blow and doors that give way. Limits: more force means more danger to the people they hit; holding back takes conscious effort, and excessive force is a legal problem for heroes and civilians alike.
